facts.claim: Porto's municipal tourist tax is EUR 3 per person per night, up to a maximum of seven consecutive nights (EUR 21), in force since 1 December 2024; guests aged 13 and over pay and children aged 12 and under are exempt, with proof.

sources.title: Porto City Council: Taxa Municipal Turística do Porto

facts.claim: Porto exempts children aged 12 and under, stays motivated by medical treatment (plus two companions), guests with a disability or incapacity of 60% or more (plus two companions), displaced people, the first night in pilgrim hostels, people housed by public social bodies and asylum seekers; exemptions need supporting evidence.

articles/where-to-stay-in-porto.html: Children aged 12 and under
guests with a disability of 60% or more, and two companions
Exemptions need proof

facts.claim: On 25 September 2026 Lusa reported that Porto council would vote the following Tuesday on starting the administrative procedure to amend the tourist tax regulation; the proposal named no value, and in July the mayor had admitted raising the tax from three to four euros. No decision was found.

sources.title: Observador / Lusa: Câmara do Porto vota início do processo de revisão da taxa turística (25 Sep 2026)

articles/where-to-stay-in-porto.html: the proposal named no figure

facts.claim: Vila Nova de Gaia's city tax (taxa de cidade) is EUR 3 per night for guests aged 16 and over, up to seven consecutive nights per person per stay; Regulamento n.º 970/2026 was published on 22 July 2026 and enters into force 30 days after publication; it was EUR 2.50 before. Medical stays (one companion) and disability of 60%+ are exempt; groups travelling for work, study, sport or culture pay 50%.

sources.title: Diário da República: Regulamento n.º 970/2026, de 22 de julho (Gaia)

articles/where-to-stay-in-porto.html: Guests aged 16 and over
€3 from 30 days after its publication on 22 July 2026; it was €2.50 before
groups travelling for work, study or sport pay half

facts.claim: Hotel-type accommodation falls under the reduced 6% VAT rate (item 2.17 of List I of the CIVA), which applies only to the accommodation price, including breakfast if not invoiced separately, according to a binding ruling published by Portal das Finanças (PIV 24650, 2023). The ruling does not itself say mainland.

sources.title: Portal das Finanças: ficha doutrinária, processo 24650

item 2.17 of the VAT code's List I

facts.claim: Our arithmetic: two adults for four nights pay 2 x 4 x EUR 3 = EUR 24 in Porto or Gaia; with a 14-year-old the Porto total is EUR 36 and Gaia's stays EUR 24; nine nights are capped at seven, so EUR 42 for two adults.

facts.claim: Visit Porto's Historic District (Porto and Gaia) lists Ponte Luís I, Palácio da Bolsa, São Bento station, Ribeira, the Sé, the Clérigos Tower, the Alfândega and Port wine caves, and calls the historic centres of Porto and Gaia the ideal choice for UNESCO World Cultural Heritage.

articles/where-to-stay-in-porto.html: Visit Porto groups the Historic District around Ribeira
describes the historic centres of Porto and Gaia as the choice for UNESCO World Heritage

facts.claim: Visit Porto's Downtown (Baixa) district covers Avenida dos Aliados, the Bolhão market, Rua de Santa Catarina, the Coliseu, Igreja do Carmo, Jardim da Cordoaria, Bombarda, Batalha and Rua de Cedofeita, and says it truly comes alive at night.

articles/where-to-stay-in-porto.html: Visit Porto's Downtown district covers Avenida dos Aliados, the Bolhão market, Rua de Santa Catarina

facts.claim: Visit Porto's Boavista district lists Casa da Música, the Palácio de Cristal, the Botanical Garden, the Bom Sucesso market and the Faculty of Architecture, and describes a mix of modern and traditional architecture and many international companies.

articles/where-to-stay-in-porto.html: Visit Porto's Boavista district brings together Casa da Música, the Palácio de Cristal

facts.claim: Visit Porto's Atlantic district covers Foz, beaches, seafront promenades, the Pérgola da Foz and the Parque da Cidade, described as the largest urban park in the country at over 85 hectares and the only European park beside the sea.

facts.claim: Infante Sagres: Praça D. Filipa de Lencastre 62; 85 rooms and suites; full renovation completed in 2024; summer terrace and plunge pool with seasonal closure from 6 October.

facts.claim: Grande Hotel do Porto: Rua de Santa Catarina 197, pedestrian street with restricted car access; classical style from 1880; 94 rooms; standard rooms 14-17 m2; five minutes from São Bento station by the hotel's count; gym and terrace.
